input.summary: Make the 12-month fee cap mutual and agreement-wide, and carve out indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence and wilful misconduct.
input.comment: [Playbook] Our position is a mutual cap of 12 months' fees, so we have made the existing cap apply to both parties across the Agreement rather than to TrueLink alone under selected sections. We have also placed indemnification and confidentiality breaches (alongside gross negligence and wilful misconduct) outside the cap.

ops.oldText: IN NO EVENT SHALL TRUELINK'S LIABILITY FOR ANY MATTER ARISING UNDER OR RELATED TO SECTION 3, 4, 7 AND 11 THIS AGREEMENT (OTHER THAN DUE TO A BREACH RESULTING FROM TRUELINK'S GROSS NEGLIGENCE OR WILLFUL MISCONDUCT) EXCEED
ops.newText: IN NO EVENT SHALL EITHER PARTY'S AGGREGATE LIABILITY FOR ANY MATTER ARISING UNDER OR RELATED TO THIS AGREEMENT (OTHER THAN A PARTY'S INDEMNIFICATION OBLIGATIONS, BREACH OF ITS CONFIDENTIALITY OBLIGATIONS, GROSS NEGLIGENCE OR WILLFUL MISCONDUCT, WHICH ARE NOT SUBJECT TO THIS LIMITATION) EXCEED
